name: io.github.lfmx233/comfy-mcp
title: ComfyUI (curated)
description: Run whitelisted ComfyUI workflows with live progress, timeouts and a replayable manifest.

environmentVariables.name: COMFYUI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the ComfyUI instance when instances.yaml is absent.

environmentVariables.name: COMFY_MCP_INSTANCES
environmentVariables.description: Path to an instances.yaml listing one or more ComfyUI instances.

environmentVariables.name: COMFY_MCP_RUNS
environmentVariables.description: Directory where per-job manifests are written and reloaded after a restart.

environmentVariables.name: COMFY_MCP_MODELS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: ComfyUI models/ directory; when set, model files are hashed into the manifest.
